en.title: Minimum Jumps Without Crossing Obstacles
en.description:
Go from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner. Each step moves 1..k cells along one axis, and every cell passed through must be empty, including the start and landing cells. Return −1 if the target is unreachable.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n m k, followed by n lines of m values that are 0/1. The original full domain 1≤n,m,k≤100 is kept. This site specifies: if either endpoint is an obstacle, return −1, including a 1×1 obstacle grid; an empty 1×1 grid gives 0.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; 2; -1. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Run BFS over empty cells, scanning up to k cells in each of the four directions and stopping at a wall; an already visited empty cell is not an obstacle, so keep scanning to farther positions.
